versions.changelog:
Initial release: End-to-end scalable talent acquisition framework for high-growth companies.

- Covers hiring process from workforce planning through 90-day onboarding.
- Includes structured pipeline architecture, job leveling, sourcing strategies, and interview scorecards.
- Offers data-driven benchmarks for time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness.
- Features diversity & inclusion best practices and onboarding checkpoints.
- Provides recruiting metrics dashboard, employer brand checklist, and common hiring pitfalls.
- Includes industry-specific hiring data and links to additional automation playbooks.
